fields.what_it_is:
Device Description:
The MCS Vector consists of an implantable coil made of bare platinum alloy. The Vector implantable
coils has a 3D shape in various loop sizes and lengths. The coil is attached to a V-Trak delivery
pusher. The proximal end is inserted into a hand held battery powered V-Grip Detachment Controller
(sold separately). The implant segment detaches upon activation of the Detachment Controller.
The table below provides information about the physical proper-ties of the MCS Vector with a

fields.indications:
Indications for Use: Intended for the endovascular embolization of intracranial
aneurysms and other neurovascular abnormalities such as
arteriovenous malformations and artiovenous fistula. The MCS
is also intended for vascular occlusion of blood vessels within
the neurovascular system to permanently obstruct blood flow to
an aneurysm or other vascular malformation and for arterial and
venous embolization in the peripheral vasculature.
